limitations: No native desktop input, screenshot, visible rendering or human feel acceptance.
No historical personal save was used; genuine historical save compatibility was not run.
Targeted six-suite run, not the full required suite; combined-branch regression is separate.
Baseline dependent placement/completion assertions fail when placement was cancelled; 28 failures are not 28 independent bugs.
Synthetic resources and accelerated timer boundary; not a 60-second wall-clock soak.
